recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce wasNotTaken/reasonNotTaken or add redundant prose; the current adherence model is the later final Pharmacy decision path.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue asking whether MedicationStatement wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven fields were relevant; the final resolution said the previous ballot comment was persuasive to rename them to wasNotTaken and reasonNotTaken.
initial_application: The seed key is not named in a git commit, but d406f9a2c0 changed the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet and examples from wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven to wasNotTaken/reasonNotTaken immediately after the 2015 Pharmacy ballot-resolution votes.
additional_context: FHIR-5701 is the prior ballot item directly requesting the rename. FHIR-11091 later left MedicationStatement naming as-is while harmonizing related resources. FHIR-8010 and FHIR-12470 revised status plus notTaken/taken guidance. Later Published Pharmacy decisions, especially FHIR-19468, FHIR-19470, FHIR-31573, and FHIR-39271, moved taking/not-taking and rationale semantics into adherence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active MedicationStatement source has no wasNotGiven or reasonNotGiven fields and defines MedicationStatement.adherence, not-taking codes, and adherence.reason for current taking/non-use semantics.
